review_role: Author-side source review; not independent scholarly validation or crossed review.

scope.inventory: All original modern-model rhyme-failed sonnets at the rebased baseline. Current generated verdicts may differ after unrelated annotation repairs.
scope.review: Only source-backed historical pair relations and exact-policy obstructions are claimed. No historical pronunciations are installed, selected to fit a partner, or inferred from the target verdict.

status_definitions.scholarly_pair_support: Same pair is explicitly identified in a scholarly historical discussion; supports rhyme feasibility, not a unique phonetic reconstruction.
status_definitions.scholarly_rule_inference: Author inference from a documented pair/rule to a different word, inflection, or source-number/form discrepancy; remains open for exact pair attestation.
status_definitions.partial_support: Evidence addresses only part of the modern difference; unresolved remainder is explicit.
status_definitions.modern_variant_only: A documented modern alternative is a diagnostic, not historical attestation.
status_definitions.open: Historical relation not established by the examined sources.
status_definitions.same_token_obstruction: Distinctness impossible for an identical normalized token under deterministic context-free lookup, irrespective of historical pronunciation.
status_definitions.scholarly_repeated_class: Scholarly observation of repeated rhyme family; rejects strict class-distinctness without implying defective verse.
status_definitions.modern_collision_open: Observed modern equality under distinct signature letters; historical identity or separation remains open.
status_definitions.source_structure: Corroborated non-fourteen-line source structure; no fourteen-position pair comparison is imposed.
status_definitions.scholarly_imperfect_analysis: The cited scholar explicitly treats the pair as imperfect rhyme, assonance, or unequal sounds. This supports a nonexact analysis; it does not rule out every other historical reconstruction.
status_definitions.scholarly_disagreement: Consulted scholars give different exactness analyses for the same pair. The historical relation remains open pending reconciliation or independent evidence.
